board: A Tasmota plug with a power meter, such as the Sonoff S31
result: See your Tasmota plug's power readings on your dashboard, switch it from anywhere, and get an email when the power passes a limit.
firstMessage: It sends its first message as soon as it connects, then a report every minute.

routine.name: Tasmota: email when the power passes a limit

connect.label: Tasmota console
connect.text: Backlog MqttHost {host}; MqttPort 1883; MqttClient {id}; MqttUser {id}; MqttPassword2 {code}; FullTopic chirp/{id}/%prefix%/; Prefix2 up; Prefix3 up; TelePeriod 60; Rule3 ON Mqtt#Connected DO Subscribe2 Warblet, chirp/{id}/down ENDON ON Event#Warblet=ON DO Power1 1 ENDON ON Event#Warblet=OFF DO Power1 0 ENDON; Rule3 1

steps.title: Check Rule1, Rule2 and Rule3 first, then paste this line
steps.text: Backlog MqttHost {host}; MqttPort 1883; MqttClient {id}; MqttUser {id}; MqttPassword2 {code}; FullTopic chirp/{id}/%prefix%/; Prefix2 up; Prefix3 up; TelePeriod 60; Rule3 ON Mqtt#Connected DO Subscribe2 Warblet, chirp/{id}/down ENDON ON Event#Warblet=ON DO Power1 1 ENDON ON Event#Warblet=OFF DO Power1 0 ENDON; Rule3 1
